name: equi7grid
title: Equi7Grid (TU Wien), v1.1 standard tilings
description: Seven continental azimuthal equidistant CRSs sharing one lattice anchored at each CRS's (0, 0), with 600/300/100 km tilings and resolution chosen separately.

crs_derived_from.note: Equi7 V14 zones (upstream v0.2.6). The v1.1 zones were redrawn later with the CRSs kept.

provenance.derived_from: src/equi7grid/_create_grids.py, core.py; CRS parameters as in the upstream README and mdsumner/equi7grid data-raw/params.csv
notes: The lattice is shared: tiles sit on multiples of the tile size from CRS (0, 0) in every continent (core.py rejects names where x or y is not a multiple of the tile size). The five-decimal false eastings/northings (x_0 = 5621452.01998 etc.) are derived: each puts the original V14 zone's projected bounding box minimum at exactly (0, 0) (all 7 continents, to micrometres; family.crs_derived_from). The v1.1 zones were redrawn with the CRSs kept, so AS, EU and OC no longer start at 0.

Upstream's per-continent min_xy (AS y = -1800000, EU y = -600000, others 0) is the lower-left of its tile matrix. It exists because the redrawn v1.1 zones reach past the V14 origin (AS to y = -1338 km, EU to y = -68 km), rounded out to the 600 km T6 tile. It is part of the domain: tiles below it don't exist even where the densified zone polygon reaches past it. Negative y is written with S in IDs (EU_E042S006T6).
Resolution is not part of the ID (v1 dropped the old 'EU500M' prefix). Any sampling dividing the tile size is allowed (upstream allowed_samplings); 500 m is what upstream's tests use.
Domain and assignment use the unbuffered zone polygons; upstream also ships buffered ones (*_zone_bfrd.parquet).
Length distortion: upstream computes k = c / sin(c) on the sphere (c = geodesic distance from the centre / a), a spherical approximation of the aeqd parallel scale.

EPSG:27701-27707 round the false easting/northing (e.g. 27704 has FE 5837287.82, FN 2121415.696, against 5837287.81977, 2121415.69617 in the PROJ strings), so the authority and proj forms in this spec differ by under 1 mm. A known-CRS-match lint should report that, not treat them as equal.
